note: Carroll County Conservation forest preserve, 155 acres of rolling oak and hickory forest at 16249 Velvet Ave, about 3.5 mi north of US 30 near Glidden, with a shelter house, playground and about 3 miles of hiking and horse trails (equestrian permit required). The campground sits under the timber; the county posts no pad sizes, so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits the sites is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14 30-amp electric ($10 tent), FCFS no reservations, 20 sites (12 + 8 equestrian), pit toilet, season mid-April to mid-October. potable_water false -> true (brochure: 'primitive restrooms and water'); dump added. Note cleaned. Stays not waterfront.
